page.overview:
Who is Yutaka Amano?

Yutaka Amano was a Ravenclaw student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the 1990s. He was seen walking around the school during the 1993–1994 school year.

Yutaka is a common male Japanese name. The most common way of writing the name with kanji characters is 豊, in that case, Yutaka means "rich". Amano is a Japanese name, which means "heavenly plain".
